scope_summary: Implemented the runner-neutral task-executor phase contract under .red/contracts/ with a schema, validator, fixtures, and a CI hook. No /afk runtime changes; no commit/merge behavior moved into the executor.
non_goals: Wire /afk to invoke the executor or consume its envelope
Add a Claude Code packaged sub-agent under plugins/dev/agents/
Modify the existing afk-task or issue-analyzer schemas or fixtures
Move commit/merge behavior into the executor

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Fixture coverage validates parsing of executor outputs, including malformed or incomplete output.

execution.implementation_summary: Added .red/contracts/task-executor.md (canonical phase contract) and task-executor.schema.json (draft 2020-12 with closed envelope + execution object, conditional requirements for completed/blocked/escalation_needed). Added a jq-only validator and a fixture-driven test wired into red-release.yml, plus 5 fixtures spanning happy path, escalation, and three failure modes. CHANGES.md records the addition.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: The executor contract references existing AFK issue/handoff concepts and preserves issue-native execution.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Document Inputs as the issue body + handoff elements + previous attempts + human guidance + analyzer envelope, and explicitly forbid creating a new docs/plans/tasks queue.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: The contract defines structured success, blocked, and escalation outputs compatible with #205.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Extend the base envelope with phase=const execute_task, keep the status enum identical, and reuse the conditional blocked/escalation requirements from afk-task.schema.json.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: The executor scope rules prevent out-of-scope file changes and explain when to escalate.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Add Scope rules (no commit, no quality gates, no out-of-scope writes, no new queues), encode the execute-phase invariants in the schema, and have the validator enforce empty verification arrays and the subset-rule on files_touched.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: The executor requires explicit acceptance-criteria tracking and non-goal preservation.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Require execution.changes_by_criterion (one entry per acceptance criterion with files_touched + approach + status) and execution.non_goals_preserved in the schema; validator rejects missing or malformed entries.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: Fixture coverage validates parsing of executor outputs, including malformed or incomplete output.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Two valid fixtures (happy path and escalation) plus three negative fixtures (missing execution object, malformed JSON, completed with no changed_files); fixture runner asserts expected outcomes and key error fragments.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: No commit/merge behavior is moved into the executor; quality and commit remain owned by later phases.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Schema forces verification_commands/verification_results/quality_gate_failures to be empty arrays; doc Scope rule 1 forbids commit/merge; doc Status of this contract section reiterates /afk continues to use the existing sentinels.

changes_by_criterion.criterion: The same executor contract can be rendered for Claude Code native agents and Codex phased execution.
changes_by_criterion.approach: Per-runner emission section describes the Claude Code sub-agent packaging path and the Codex inlined-phase path emitting the same envelope, mirroring the issue-analyzer pattern; public copy avoids the 'Codex sub-agent' label per #204 §4.

non_goals_preserved: Did not wire /afk to invoke the executor or consume its envelope
Did not add or modify any files under plugins/dev/agents/ or plugins/dev/skills/engineering/afk/
Did not edit afk-task or issue-analyzer schemas, validators, or fixtures

commit_hint.subject: feat(contracts): #200 add task-executor phase contract
commit_hint.body:
Minimal runner-neutral execute_task phase contract built on top of the #205 envelope. Specialises the base AFK task envelope with an `execution` object and enforces the execute-phase invariants (no quality gates, no commits, all acceptance results unverified, completed requires non-empty changed_files and all changes_by_criterion implemented).

Documentation/contract-only: /afk is not rewired to invoke the executor or consume its envelope. Production wiring is deferred to later PRD #196 slices. Codex emission is described as an inlined phase per #204 §4.

Refs #200

follow_ups: Package the executor as plugins/dev/agents/task-executor.md once #198 lands the agent-metadata validator wiring for new agents.
Wire /afk to extract and validate the executor envelope alongside the analyzer envelope in the production slice.
